description: This file defines functions and types related to resolving and handling approval session targets in an OpenClaw system, including session key parsing, session store loading, and target resolution logic.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalString
methods.description: Normalizes an optional string by trimming whitespace or returning undefined if null or empty.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalThreadId
methods.description: Converts a string or number to a finite number or returns undefined.

methods.name: isExecApprovalRequest
methods.description: Type guard to check if a request is an ExecApprovalRequest.

methods.name: toExecLikeApprovalRequest
methods.description: Converts a generic ApprovalRequestLike to an ExecApprovalRequest.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalSessionTarget
methods.description: Resolves an execution approval session target based on session key and store data.

methods.name: resolveApprovalRequestSessionTarget
methods.description: Resolves session target from an approval request.

methods.name: resolveApprovalRequestStoredSessionTarget
methods.description: Resolves stored session target from an approval request.

methods.name: resolveApprovalRequestOriginTarget
methods.description: Resolves the origin target for an approval request, considering channel and account matching.
